text:
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: release/redwood-serving@v2.1.9 -> prod (staged canary)  

 deploy-bot: Auto-smoke summary: overall health=OK, global synthetic=pass, eu-west-edge synthetic p95=360ms (baseline 120ms), 5xx=0.6% (baseline 0.05%) :warning:  

 alexa: seeing the eu-west spike too, started at ~02:14 UTC. :eyes:  

 sam: any obvious errors in logs or OOMs?  

 jorge: quick grep shows repeated kv-cache warnings on host gpu-q2-03, messages like "kv_cache_eviction_soft" followed by `cuda_mem_pressure` traces. not full OOMs.  

 mira: interesting — spikes correlate with seq_len>1024 requests in canary trace. could be a kernel selection regression in quantized path.  

 alexa: rolling this to 10% already? what's current traffic split?  

 deploy-bot: Traffic: prod=100% (canary rollout flag=on -> routing jitter still present). current per-region: eu-west=12% variant=redwood-quant-v2.  

 sam: my vote: HOLD rollout for eu-west, PIN to previous model variant redwood-quant-v1 for eu-west only, don't rollback globally. less blast radius.  

 mira: +1 to pin. engineering time to diagnose kernel fallback path.  

 alexa: @sam can you coordinate the pin and release note blurb to support? i'll draft a customer-facing note if needed.  

 sam: on it. creating rollout-hold and pin task, will update routing table.  

 deploy-bot: Pin action executed: eu-west routing pinned -> redwood-quant-v1 (traffic 100% for eu-west). Canary remains for other regions.  

 ops-bot: Created incident INC-2026-3412 (label: postdeploy-eu-latency). Assigned to oncall-ci.  

 oncall-ci: running targeted synthetic against eu-west edge now. sample curl below:  

 ```
 $ curl -s -D- -o /dev/null "https://eu-west.api.redwood.run/v1/healthcheck?route=embed" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED"
 HTTP/1.1 200 OK
 X-Server-Latency: 362ms
 X-Kernel: quant-path

 {"status":"ok","p95_ms":362}
 ```

 oncall-ci: after pin synthetic p95 dropped to 118ms on second run. confirming improvement.  

 jorge: logs post-pin show kernel fallback to legacy kernels on q2 hosts. toggling kernel selector to prefer legacy reduces latency but may increase cost.  

 mira: we'll schedule a hotfix to fix kernel selection: target change window 03:45-04:30 UTC, ETA ~90m for rollout and verification.  

 sam: agreed. i'll update release notes: note the hold and pin for eu-west, include workaround and ETA for fix.  

 alexa: thanks team. i'll keep customers informed if latency continues. :thumbsup:  

 deploy-bot: Rollback not performed. Rollout held and pinned for eu-west. Monitoring window 30m. Will escalate if 5xx >1% or p95 > 300ms.  

 oncall-ci: will post follow-ups in INC-2026-3412. closing thread here when stable.  

 sam: arch ticket created: ARCH-1259 (investigate quant-kernel selector + seq_len hotpath).  

 mira: good. next steps: hotfix engineering, schedule canary for kernel tweak, expand after 1h stable in eu-west.  

 alexa: copy.
